calls.reasoning: Live homepage on 2026-11-17 shows 30-60% off everything, 40-60%, all clearance 60% off+, extra 20% WOW20 -> current resolution value 60. Normal-year TCP Black Friday homepages advertised 60-70% off sitewide (2025), and Feb 2026 had 50-70% with clearance up to 75%.
